## Balancing (Spells)
* Laser Pointere -- COST 4 > 3. {green}
* Powerhouse -- EFFECT UPDATE: Draw a card and give all cards in your hand -2 cost (min. 1). {green}
* Proceed -- EFFECT UPDATE: Silence a non-DT monster. It attacks all of its enemy monsters. {red}
* Star Blazing -- EFFECT UPDATE: Erase 15 random monsters not generated by Star Blazing in your dustpile. Summon a Star for every 3 erased. Give them +1/+1 for each not summoned. {red}
## Balancing (Artifacts)
* Will -- EFFECT UPDATE: At the start of the game, add a Recruitment to your hand. At the end of your 6th turn, give all ally monsters +1/+1. {green}
* Draw -- EFFECT UPDATE: At the start of the game and on every 5th turn, draw a card unless your hand is full. {green}
* Ultimate Showdown -- EFFECT UPDATE: Starts with 3 counters. After an ally Queen dies, spend a counter to return it to your deck with +1/+2/+2 base stats. After an ally Queen dies at 0 counters, add Detachable Hands to your hand and disable this. {green}
* Seedlings -- EFFECT UPDATE: Turn end: Erase 6 non-TOKEN monsters in your dustpile to summon a Red Flower. {red}
* Reinforcement -- EFFECT UPDATE: At the start of every 10th turn, add 3 Drafts to your hand and send any that didn't fit to your deck. At the end of every 10th turn, give all monsters in your hand +1/+1. {red}
